publicReleaseNotes: The monitor list header names only locations a monitor checks from. It used to name every location that was not removed, so a location still waiting to join, or used by no monitor, appeared in "from Cloudflare Worker and Misty Hill" although every monitor checked from the Worker alone. Product screenshot available from Uptime 0.4.0 at 1440 pixels (.github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png). — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-26
